name: scoring
title: Scores
citation: Whelan CD, Smith-Byrne K. Atlas of Proteomic Technologies: an evidence-based framework for selecting and combining commercial proteomics platforms. bioRxiv 2026. https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.10.750723
provenance: Claude drafted the first scores, and the authors scored the platforms before opening that draft, then compared the two sets and adjudicated. Every score change, before and since release, was decided by Whelan and Smith-Byrne; Claude made edits only on their instruction. The prompt file generated in the same session as the draft also told the build to adjust scores so that platform totals fell between 28 and 33; the authors did not set this range or use platform totals when scoring or adjudicating.
class_balance_provenance: class_balance, a Help Me Combine axis, is not one of the ten scored dimensions. It is computed, not assigned: the normalised Shannon entropy of the target classes among the drug targets a pair covers, using nine ChEMBL/UniProt classes with Unclassified excluded, divided by ln(9). It is therefore derived from the ChEMBL drug-target list. The per-protein list is not published here, so the values can be checked but not regenerated from these files alone.

lower_confidence.rule: A platform with an evidence-depth score of 2 or lower has its other scores flagged as provisional. The flag never changes a score, ranking or recommendation.

dimensions.label: Specificity

dimensions.label: Cost per sample

dimensions.label: Multi-Matrix Validation
dimensions.description: Breadth of sample matrices with published validation (plasma, serum, CSF, tissue, cell lysate)

dimensions.label: pQTL Accuracy
